_comment: Single source of truth for headline-theorem statuses. scripts/ledger.sh VALIDATES every entry: a status of proven or proven_fragment requires (a) no sorry in the file, (b) the declared witness module to build, (c) the axiom snapshot to match. Docs (README/RELEASES/paper/draft-ietf) may not claim more than this file says — scripts/check-claims.sh enforces. Status vocabulary: proven | proven_fragment | stated | open | vacuous.

T3_noninterference.proven_content: FUNDAMENTAL LEMMA proven (DLC/NonInterferenceFundamental.lean, fundamental): every core PropDeriv derivation maps LRel-related closed environments to LRel-related instances, over the redesigned relation LRel (DLC/NonInterferenceLR.lean) and congruent reduction. Corollary t3_two_run_general: an observable-typed core computation cannot distinguish two ARBITRARY closed instantiations of a high-labeled hypothesis — genuine two-run non-interference, the first mechanized NI for a says-logic in Lean. lrel_self gives reflexivity-on-well-typed (which the PER refused for free). Witness DLC/Witness/T3.lean: an ELIMINATION (fst) at an observable atom type concludes Joinable (non-vacuous), typing load-bearing. Ladder rungs 1,2,3a,3b-0,3b,3c all in spec/t3-two-run-design-2026-07.md.

declassify remains excluded by design (NI modulo declassification is the correct statement; unrestricted declassify falsifies NI)
T3_noninterference.fragment: propositional computational core (PropDeriv minus the frozen eliminations verify/attenuate/declassify/discharge; NI modulo declassification)

T4_obligation.fragment: non-introduction only (t4_no_new_obligation): reduction never invents an obligation absent from the redex. The full multiset accounting obligations(M') = obligations(M) - discharged + introduced is NOT proven; this is one inequality of it.
T4_obligation.proven_content: NO LONGER VACUOUS as of the R0-R5 ladder (spec/t4-obligation-design-2026-07.md). Previously pendingObligations was provably the constant [] (pendingObligations_eq_nil), so the ~180-line induction quantified over an empty list. R1-R3 added Term.boxed, the obligation-carrying introduction form -- Deriv.boxI had concluded at Term.app, so obligations never inhabited syntax. R4 added discharge-beta, a redex that DESTROYS a box. R5 gave pendingObligations its base case, so a box contributes its own obligation. pendingObligations_eq_nil is now FALSE and deleted; pendingObligations_ne_nil refutes it. Witness DLC/Witness/T4.lean exhibits a term with obligation list [Ow] (impossible before this ladder), a discharge-beta step that REMOVES it, and T4 applied to that concrete step -- so the theorem is exercised on a rule that can fire and a list that can be non-empty.
T4_obligation.history: the deleted pendingObligations_eq_nil pre-registered its own refutation: 'When Phase 2 adds an obligation-carrying constructor, this lemma MUST break -- its deletion is the signal that T4 has acquired content.'
open: multiset accounting: obligations(M') = obligations(M) - discharged + introduced (only the non-introduction inequality is proven)
label-ledger fusion: discharging an obligation cannot leak below its label

decideLean is FAIL-CLOSED on Term.boxed: decide.rs ignores obligation evidence while Deriv.boxI requires dN : Deriv Ctx.empty N (atom 0), so a faithful Lean arm must be STRICTER than the Rust. Unresolved -- the discharge arm already carries the same asymmetry
full-Deriv (non-propositional) content of discharge-beta

Typed substitution preservation for PropDeriv lives in DLC/Decidability.lean.

linear_lever_L1.fragment: L1 disambiguation: varL restricted to var(additive.length); CtxWellFormed holds by construction; ctxLookup agrees with the var rules and matches decide.rs on the additive + empty-additive-linear domains
linear_lever_L1.finding: ctxLookup_ne_checker_witness (machine-checked): disambiguated Deriv is STRICTLY MORE EXPRESSIVE than decide.rs — the shipped checker refuses a linear var under a nonempty additive context (consults linear only at index 0, shadowed by additive[0]). The checker is INCOMPLETE w.r.t. Deriv here, not unsound. Closing it is a decide.rs change, separate item. | L2 FINDING (2026-07-20): the deferred LinearSplitRoutes Prop was FALSE as stated, not merely unproven. It lacked the additive-miss hypothesis (ctxLookup consults additive first, so an additive hit leaves the linear halves unconstrained) AND mis-scoped the index claim by precedence (i = len ∧ A ∨ B parses as (i = len ∧ A) ∨ B). Its docstring had correctly certified it was not a sorry and not a tautology -- neither of which implies truth. Corrected, proven as linearSplitRoutes_holds, and the old form kept refuted as linearSplitRoutes_old_form_refuted.

L4 linear substitution preservation (the substructural core; needs L1+L2, multi-week)
L5 subject reduction over full Deriv, then T3-full / T1-full / progress-full
decide.rs completeness fix for nonempty-additive linear vars (separate, checker-side)

_dlcd_comment: DLC-D (distributed) headline guarantees. Each is a top-level, machine-checked DLCD.* theorem re-exported by DLCD/Summary.lean and axiom-snapshotted in lean/expected-axioms/dlcd-*.txt (all within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]). status=proven means the theorem is fully proved AS STATED about the DLC-D model; the notes record the SCOPE FENCES (what the model does and does not cover). The joint non-vacuity witness is DLCD/Witness.lean's SliceWitness.dlc_d_slice_witness — one inhabited bundle on a single real 2-replica execution simultaneously satisfying G1-G4.

DLCD_capability_safety.proven_content: capability_safety (G1, authority): every command in a WellFormedLog carries a genuine Deriv (issuer says writeCap) credential — authority enforced by construction, not audited after the fact.
DLCD_capability_safety.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime — a guarantee about the Lean model, not dlc-verifier's Rust at run time; (2) saysI-on-CDeriv — the CARVe-migrated CDeriv judgment does not yet carry the signed says credential the capability layer uses.
open: carry the signed says credential on CDeriv so the capability layer runs on the migrated judgment

DLCD_log_noninterference.proven_content: log_noninterference (G1, semantic confidentiality): a labelled log's low-observable projection is independent of its high inputs.

DLCD_distributed_noninterference.proven_content: distributed_noninterference (G1, typed confidentiality across replicas): reuses DLC's fundamental-lemma non-interference (DLC.t3_two_run_general).
DLCD_distributed_noninterference.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime; (2) confidentiality strength INHERITS T3_noninterference's propositional-core fragment scope (it consumes DLC.t3_two_run_general, which is proven_fragment over the propositional computational core, NI modulo declassification).
open: inherits T3's open items: extend from PropDeriv to the full Deriv judgment with linear context splitting

DLCD_wellTypedLog_implies_htyped.proven_content: wellTypedLog_implies_htyped (G1): a well-typed committed log discharges the host-typing premise that distributed_noninterference consumes, so the typed guarantee actually fires on real logs. worldStep_preserves_low_typed removes the raw htyped assumption via a WellTypedLog admission gate.
DLCD_wellTypedLog_implies_htyped.note: SCOPE FENCE: model, not runtime; the admission gate is a modelled well-typedness check, not a running validator.

DLCD_single_linearization.proven_content: single_linearization (G2): all replicas' observed stores are samples of ONE sequential trajectory seqTrajectory init log at their own applied index — a single linearization order respected by all.
DLCD_single_linearization.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime; (2) store-type change — the committed store is a fixed Term; a richer store type is future work.
open: generalize the linearization result to a richer store type than the fixed Term

DLCD_weakfair_terminates.proven_content: weakfair_terminates (G3, single-decree progress): under weak fairness a single decree is eventually decided.
DLCD_weakfair_terminates.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime; (2) live-scheduling — the weak-fairness/delivery schedule feeding liveness is modelled, not tied to a running scheduler; (3) leader election — quorums are given, not elected. Uses Classical.choice (fair-schedule extraction).
open: tie the modelled fairness schedule to a running scheduler / FailureBudget closure

DLCD_log_grows_unbounded.proven_content: log_grows_unbounded (G3, multi-decree liveness): under a fair slot schedule the multi-decree committed log grows without bound.
DLCD_log_grows_unbounded.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime; (2) live-scheduling — the fair slot schedule is modelled, not tied to a running scheduler. Uses Classical.choice.
open: tie the modelled fair slot schedule to a running scheduler / FailureBudget closure

DLCD_replicas_converge_via_consensus.proven_content: replicas_converge_via_consensus (G4, coordination-based convergence): replicas that deliver a quorum-Decided value reach EQUAL stores.
DLCD_replicas_converge_via_consensus.note: SCOPE FENCES: (1) model, not runtime; (2) leader election — quorums are given, not elected. Uses Classical.choice.
open: leader election: derive the quorum rather than assuming it

DLCD_coordination_free_convergence.proven_content: Calm.coordination_free_convergence (G4, CALM route): monotone/commutative updates converge with NO coordination (robust to reordering AND duplication).

DLCD_log_agreement_eq.proven_content: log_agreement_eq (G4, multi-decree safety/agreement): two logs agreeing on the per-slot ballots are equal.
DLCD_log_agreement_eq.note: SCOPE FENCE: model, not runtime. Uses Classical.choice.

DLCD_slice_witness.proven_content: SliceWitness.dlc_d_slice_witness (the seal, a def): one inhabited SliceWitnessBundle on a single real 2-replica execution that is simultaneously capability-authorized, consensus-committed, converging, linearizable, and live — THE demonstration that G1-G4 are jointly satisfiable, not vacuously true. Its existence is the non-vacuity witness the other DLCD entries point at; DLCD/Summary.lean re-exports it under a name-drift tripwire.
DLCD_slice_witness.note: SCOPE FENCES (inherited, joint): model not runtime; store-type change; live-scheduling; saysI-on-CDeriv; leader election; surface syntax (examples in abstract syntax, not the concrete surface language). def-shaped seal: an inhabited bundle IS a proof of joint satisfiability.
